objects.name: PKG_CUSTOMER
objects.sourceSpec:
----------------------------------------------------------
-- PACKAGE
----------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE PKG_CUSTOMER
AS

TYPE CUSTOMER_REC IS RECORD
(
    ID NUMBER,
    NAME VARCHAR2(100),
    STATUS VARCHAR2(20)
)
objects.sourceBody:
----------------------------------------------------------
-- PACKAGE BODY
----------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY PKG_CUSTOMER
AS

----------------------------------------------------------
-- PROCEDURE
----------------------------------------------------------

PROCEDURE ADD_CUSTOMER
(
    P_NAME VARCHAR2,
    P_EMAIL VARCHAR2,
    P_PHONE VARCHAR2,
    P_INCOME NUMBER
)
IS
BEGIN

    INSERT INTO CUSTOMER
    (
        CUSTOMER_NAME,
        EMAIL,
        PHONE,
        ANNUAL_INCOME
    )
    VALUES
    (
        P_NAME,
        P_EMAIL,
        P_PHONE,
        P_INCOME
    )

objects.name: SEQ_KYC
objects.sourceSpec: CREATE SEQUENCE SEQ_KYC START WITH 5000 INCREMENT BY 1

objects.name: TRG_CUSTOMER
objects.sourceSpec:
----------------------------------------------------------
-- TRIGGERS
----------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER TRG_CUSTOMER
BEFORE INSERT ON CUSTOMER
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF :NEW.CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL THEN
        :NEW.CUSTOMER_ID := SEQ_CUSTOMER.NEXTVAL

objects.name: TRG_KYC
objects.sourceSpec:
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER TRG_KYC
BEFORE INSERT ON KYC
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF :NEW.KYC_ID IS NULL THEN
        :NEW.KYC_ID := SEQ_KYC.NEXTVAL
